reviews.text: Best and most comprehensive app. I am in love with this app. It is the best for finding the obscure. I could never find the nutritional content of my favorite cappuccino at 7-11. I was always stumped and guessing. As a type 1 diabetic guessing is never a great idea. This app has the best and accurate nutritional content. It is a must if you are on any weight loss program and a must for diabetics.
Great app. Great app so far!
Amazing App. This app has helped me cut carbs, eat healthy and lose weight.

Great Alternative!. Are you looking for a great alternative to the WW app? Look no farther my fluffy friend. It’s actually kind of fun to calculate your way through your day. If you can stay focused, you can manage your weight. This is a pretty extensive compilation of foods from restaurant menus (Think McDonald’s to Panda Express to Popeye’s to Longhorn Steak House and everything in between. It includes everyday favorites like hard boiled eggs, chicken breast, thousand island dressing and a slice of bread. You can easily look up ingredients like one cup of rice, one teaspoon of sugar, one tablespoon of honey. There are very few things I couldn’t find. I haven’t really felt the need to calculate food point values from scratch by entering calories, fiber, carbs, sugar, etc. However, this app can do that too! You get all this for free. You really can’t beat that!

Helpful. This app has helped me with my type 2 diabetes. If I need to no how many carbs is in a food it is easy to look it up on this app. The amount of restaurants that is in this app is just amazing.

Smart food calculator. This is a great app that easily calculates points in food. I cancelled my weight watchers because I didn’t like the smart points program and was more successful on the older program. This saves me money by being able to use the old program. Thank you for creating this app!

Gold star. The app is very good at helping me to stay on track. It is simple to use and most all of my frequently used foods are listed. They made the app user friendly and easy to navigate. It is simple to use so that even the not so tech savvy can use without a struggle. The app even includes restaurants. I love the scan in feature for use with barcodes. That makes it even easier to use, as it takes the search step out for quick computing. I was looking for a quick and easy app to calculate my food points and I have that with this app!

Definitely a 5 Star!. This is the best app out there to help you count points and keep on track. 
I have only used this app a few days now, but by scanning my food or typing ingredients in, it has helped me keep on track. 
So far by using smart points, I have already lost a few pounds. 
I can’t thank the developers enough for such a great job. 
You can also see the calories, fat and carbs as well as the WW points which keeps me on my daily points. 
I have looked at other apps but there’s just no comparison with this one. 
Thanks smart points for helping people who need this!!

Pretty cool. As a professional athlete I definitely like this app. I have to be on a very strict diet when training and this app helps me keep track of what I’m eating even on cheat meals. I like the different search options as well. If you’re curious about what you eat this app is just for you!

If we are going out to eat, I now have a pretty good idea of what to order by checking the values before getting to the restaurant. Now that I am eating healthier I am down 14 pounds and my wife says my snoring has virtually stopped. This is great tool.

Since I’m a teenager it allows me easy access to something I know little about which is calculating my weight watcher points. The best part is that it has an offline version so if u are somewhere without service but you want a snack you can easily calculate your points with a pinch of a button. It also has a restaurant setting so you can look at the menus and it will tell you what everything is worth. This app is so worth it In my opinion.
Great point calculator!. Easy to use. Accurate. User friendly. Highly revommended!
Great app. Been trying to find a good app to track food with ease. Fairly simple and works well. I’m looking forward to the great results.

WW app. Great app, very informative, easy to read and follow and use.Breakdown of points is very easy to understand. The app will help me better manage what I eat and to eat healthier. Also helps me to be less obsessed with calorie counting, carb counting and focusing on all of that stuff instead of nutrition

Helpful and Easy to use. This app is very simple and easy to use as a calculator for different foods. I would like to see them add a tracking diary to it which would be more helpful but as a simple calculator it works great

reviews.text: Review. This app is a great way to calculate my food intake and can definitely help me to not only lose weight but eat healthier and make better food choices especially for being diabetic and it’s great way to track my daily meals and for restaurant meals as well so it will definitely help me to keep the weight off and maintain my weight as well
Yay. I love this app so much. It gives so many options and ease of use. Gonna keep using it. Thanks!!!!!!

Time Saver. I don't write too many reviews. As a matter of fact this is my third review that I have ever written. This app is a time saver. It has all the calculations for you for all the most popular restaurants. Not only that, but I love the way that it gives you the options between classic points, points plus, and smart points. There are many other great features as well and I love the fact that you can search online as well as off line. If you are doing WW then this is a great comapion app to have. I you have ever done WW but are not anymore you will definitely be familiar and comfortable using this app. Either way using this app is a win-win for those looking to start your lifestyle change journey or for those of you who are already well into your journey!
Wonderful!. I’ve been looking for a good WW point calculator - I think I’ve found the best! 👍🏻

What a great tool!. You must download this program. You will be amazed how easy it is to use. I got this app and I cannot believe how great it is. This program is very easy to use. I love all the tools at my fingertips. This app is similar to weight watchers though I find it better! I like being able to check restaurants on it so I can plan my meals.
As soon as I downloaded the program I was excited about all the items that I can review. I have told my other friends about it and now they have downloaded the program so we can support each other. You will not miss weight watchers calculator.

Wow.. Easy to use! And it gives you the option of which point system you want to use. (This is very good because I hate the new WW.) Even the free version is extremely helpful. I just hate it took so long to find it. If you’re so serious about loosing weight, and not having to go to the dreaded WW meetings- GET THIS APP!! :)

What a helper!. This app will be such a help tracking carbs and calories to keep me on my diet! I love the restaurant search and barcode search. Saves so much time and you know you’re accurate, not guessing. Thank you!

Good source of dietary information. I downloaded this app to assist me in planning meals. I am a type 2 diabetic and my wife is pre-diabetic. With this app we can try new recipes and be confident we stay within our goals. It also helps us plan meals when dining with friends that are dieting so we can stay within their requirements. And the large database of restaurants means we can dine out and not have to worry about going over on our carb intake. A very good and helpful app that I would recommend to all of my friends.

Manual Calculator Doesn’t Work. I like the idea of this app, but when I enter in information for the manual calculator, it just takes me to a blank page that says nutritional calculator. The app also doesn’t keep a log so it’s only purpose is to lookup the food. I also don’t understand the purpose of selecting the plan when it shows you all three options anyways. Kind of disappointed, but will still use to be able to look up foods easily and not have to calculate on my own. Will just have to keep a separate log.

reviews.text: Smart point. I really think this app will help me Bc the items are so accessible. I truly love the barcode function of the app it makes life easier. I also really like the way a pie is made of everything I’ve eaten. And a simple breakdown is made as well. In the long run I feel this app will be useful for a long time after I complete my goals.

Great!!!. This app has tons of restaurants stored. It has been a lifesaver! Just like the ww system. Wish I had found this sooner. Has tons of restaurants with accurate smartpoint readings!! The best part is, it’s FREE!
Fun. So far, I’m enjoying this app but they are requiring a hundred character review in order to get the full features, a questionable requirement, in my opinion.

Works okay. It doesn’t seem to calculate your food if it isn’t already in the app. 

It doesn’t do anything after you take the time to input all of the information by hand. 

Restaurant food works if it’s already in there. So does grocery store food. 

It would be nice if it also tracked what you ate every day. That shouldn’t be a feature that’s too hard to add.

reviews.text: Great plan. Such a good app. Detailed nutritional facts and so easy to follow. Can’t believe it. It’s worth the while to follow this app. It has a good diet plan and exercise plan as well

Great App!. I just downloaded this app and so far I like what I see. Both my wife and I are long time users of the WW app, and have been a member on and off for years. We have been through many different plans with them and over the years the cost of these programs has risen to the point where they are unaffordable for us now. I decided to try a more cost effective way to manage our weight. This app is easy to use and seems to give the same results. We are looking forward to a using the app to maintain a healthy lifestyle.
Smart points. So far I've found everything that I wanted to look Up. Just got this app today

It really works.. So I wanted to do weight Watchers but I am cheap. (LoL). So found this app and it’s awesome. You can scan all your foods and search if you don’t have the barcode. I have only been using this for app for a week and I’ve already lost 2 pounds!!. Only 68 more to go!. If you want to hold yourself accountable use this app. You won’t regret it. It also tracks all the weight watchers points systems, so no matter which one you use it all all the point calculator.

Easy. This app is just what I was looking for. You get all the nutritional information and values for just about every food you could want. The app also gives nutritional values for food in many of the main stream restaurants.

Smart points food calculator. This new app is very easy to use. It has a food bank of almost any food one can choose. It also has a barcode scan option that works quickly and accurately. A feature few apps have is the capability and flexibility for the user to select a classic and a smart plan based a on the diet the particular dieter prefers. It also calculates your weight, height, age, and activity level to reach the calculations to reach your goal and tracks whatever you record. One of the features I most appreciate is the lack of interruptions asking the user to upgrade so every calculation isn’t accompanied by the need to X out the upgrade page. This is a wonderful app for dieters
Simple and easy. It looks pretty simple to navigate and it has a ton of restaurants to choose from. There are 3 points options to choose from, which is nice...and it gives the points value for all 3.

Good app so far. So far I really enjoy this app. My wife is a long time user of the Wait W@tchers app, and has been a member for about 16 years. She has been through many different programs with them. When I found out how much it costs per month (since she backslid a little on her weight), I decided to find a more cost effective alternative. In a short term comparison, this app seems to give very similar results. In fact when we scanned a vanilla chia bar, all of the results in the WW app where created by users, not straight from the WW database. This app actually properly pulled up the data for the bar. So far I think it’s done a good job in the short time we’ve used it.

Points. This app is really good if I am not sure on something I can go here and either scan bar code or enter into calculator and get my point value I haven’t try the restaurant part get but the food search part is really good as well. I like the part that has 3 point selection. However I am just starting out with watching my food intake and points. I did ww before and lost weight so with this app it will make it easier to keep up with my points. I will and have already mentioned this app to a couple of friends that are on ww.

Great. This app is fun and easy to use. It breaks each food down into 3 different point sets, depending on what you’re looking for with your own diet. Also gives you tons of nutrition info on each food you scan with barcode scanner.
Looks great. I’ve been looking for an app like this. So helpful and needed. Thanx
Smart Points Counter. Can’t wait to use this app. This is all new for me. To a new beginning...
Counting points. Very helpful in getting started on diet.

Mc123454321. Good thing he keeps track of your points it helps you lose weight it’s an awesome tool it’s real comparable to weight watchers barcode scanner I think you’ll get a lot out of it thank you so muchGood for you and your husband loves you eat healthier it’s great stuff

Smart Food Points. Being a diabetic is something that you are constantly battling with, especially your diet. Having an app available with a touch is an amazing way to calculate and use points to control your intake of food. Which helps you maintain your blood sugars.

Smart Points Tracker. I’m just getting started with this App. After my last doctor visit and discovering my Blood Sugar was high, along with high triglycerides, and high cholesterol, I knew I needed to make a drastic change in my eating habits. I had previously had success with Weight Watchers Plus points, and was disappointed the program changed and I could no longer use that system. This App will allow me to continue with my preferred program and ultimately lose weight and improve my health. I highly recommend you try this App.

Excellent easy calculator for ww points. This app is so easy to use and the list of pre-loaded foods is a life saver when tracking points for ww. It also gives you 3 different points options for historical ww plans. For example, if you were on weight watchers more than 10 years ago and use the “old” points system, you can still use this app. You can also use the current smart points system as well. The flexibility within the app is great. You can customize and build your own foods in the app. Also, the barcode feature is really cool. You simply scan the barcode and the points for that particular food will automatically pop up. This is an excellent tool for use in tracking your food intake.

Needtolosesome. I really think I will like this app. I’m not sure if I want to pay and join weight watchers, so I think this app will give me a fairly good idea if weight watchers is for me. From what I can tell it tracks points with three different plans. I like the restaurant feature as it seems that’s where I have my biggest challenges with meal options and portions. I also like the barcode feature, particularly for mid-day snacks, also a challenging time for me. Hopefully, this app will help me lose then maintain my weight.

All the info you need before buying. This app list all the essential information you need about what you are putting into your body before eating it. It will definitely make you think twice before buying those bags of chips. Thanks.
